notes.title: Yaffee – Keeper of the Way
notes.content:
[p]A former priestess of the Reaper cult, transformed into a key, a guide to an ancient vampire relic.[/p][p]Her identity is erased, but tied to the hero, she begins to perceive the world through his eyes.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Faces you haven't seen before🔥
notes.content:
[p]In the next continuation of Charming Blood, new faces will step out of the shadows – fleeting, mysterious, yet destined to leave their mark on your journey. [/p][p]Each encounter will pull you deeper into the darkness, where every choice whispers of consequences still unseen. [/p][p]Thank you for walking this path with us…your presence keeps the story alive. [/p][p]Stay close, the night continues🖤[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Important Update: Save/Load and Backlog Features
notes.content:
Dear All,
We've discovered an issue affecting the save/load functionality in the game. As a temporary measure, we have disabled the backlog feature while we work on resolving these issues.
Our development team is working hard to fix both features, and we expect to have everything back to normal within the next few days.
Until then, please be aware that:
You may experience difficulties with saving or loading your game progress
The backlog feature is temporarily unavailable
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this causes. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we work to improve your gaming experience.
I'll update you as soon as the fixes are ready.

Workaround:
Save (same scene) and load
